tagline: Vivitar数码单反相机，1978 年发布
description: Vivitar于1978年推出的数码单反相机。快门速度1/1000 to 4 sec, 1/50 mechanical backup, Bulb。感光度25 - 3200。Horizontal split image w/micro-prism collar。

specs.快门: Horizontal travel, electronic focal plane shutter
specs.取景器: eye-level pentaprism, -1.0 diopter, match LED display
specs.电池: 1.5v S-76, MS-76, G-13, SMC357 or equivalent (x2)
specs.英文简介: The Vivitar XC-3 is an M42 mount, 35mm SLR, marketed by Vivitar and manufactured by Cosina.
